title: LangMAP: A Language-Adaptive Approach to Tokenization
abstract: arXiv:2606.23566v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language-specific tokenizers improve tokenization quality and the downstream performance of models on those languages. Using one with an existing pretrained model requires either training a new model from scratch or adapting the vocabulary of the pretrained one. We propose Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori (LangMAP) Tokenization, which extends the UnigramLM algorithm to the multilingual setting by replacing its single distribution over the vocabulary with one distribution per language over the same vocabulary. LangMAP can be used to train a multilingual language model from scratch, or to adapt a pretrained model's tokenizer to individual languages without changing its vocabulary. Language labels are required to estimate the per-language distributions; at inference, the algorithm selects the highest-probability segmentation across languages, i.e., it does not need a language label. translated_title: LangMAP：一种语言自适应的分词方法
translated_abstract: 特定语言的分词器能够提升分词质量以及模型在这些语言上的下游任务性能。要在现有预训练模型上使用这样的分词器，要么需要从头训练一个新模型，要么需要调整预训练模型的词表。我们提出了语言自适应最大后验概率分词方法（LangMAP），该方法将 UnigramLM 算法扩展到多语言场景，通过将其单一的词表分布替换为同一词表上针对每种语言的各自分布。LangMAP 既可用于从头训练多语言语言模型，也可以在不改变词表的情况下，将预训练模型的分词器适配到各个语言。估计每种语言的分布需要语言标签；而在推理时，该算法会在各语言间选择概率最高的切分方式，即无需语言标签。在将预训练分词器进行适配的实验中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 LangMAP 分词方法，通过在共享词表上为每种语言建立独立分布，将 UnigramLM 扩展到多语言场景，既能从头训练多语言模型，也能在不改变词表的前提下将预训练分词器适配到特定语言，且推理时无需语言标签。
en_tdlr: LangMAP extends UnigramLM tokenization to the multilingual setting by maintaining one distribution per language over a shared vocabulary, enabling training multilingual models from scratch or adapting pretrained tokenizers to specific languages without changing the vocabulary, with no language label needed at inference.
